0.original: Mogmug is flitting about frantically looking for someone to do his bidding.

1.original: Mogmug has asked the newest member of his fan club─you─to gather four sankchinni vines. Head north of Moghome and gather the vines.

2.original: The sankchinnis fall easily. Gather their vines and return to Mogmug.

3.original: Mogmug is pleased at your obedience, and plans to use the vines to make a harp that will charm the attendees of the harvest fête, further expanding his army of fans.

24.original: Slay sankchinnis and collect their vines.

48.original: ...Oh! You've returned to bask in my alluring aura! One can never have too many devotees... Say, I have just the job for a fledgling fan, kupo!

49.original: I require four vines from the sankchinnis that reside north of Moghome. An ardent admirer such as yourself surely will not deny me!

50.original: I dare not soil my immaculately groomed coat. Bring me four sankchinni vines and I'll be ever so grateful!

51.original: My steadfast serv─I mean <hex:021A020203>supporter<hex:021A020103> has returned! Did the sankchinnis prove to be any trouble, kupo?

52.original: Magnificent! Marvelous! Such beauteous vines <hex:021A020203>almost<hex:021A020103> make me green with envy. With these I'll make the most harmonious harp in Moghome, and moogles for malms around will be enraptured when I perform at the harvest fête. Come and lend your voice to the cheers of my fabulous fans, kupo!
